title: Silk on the Terrace
reference_source: Бельевая линия — максимальный гламурный регистр, 8 кадров, без наушников
mood_ru: Тёплая ночь, город внизу, короткая шёлковая двойка. Ветер и свечи.
allure: lingerie editorial glamour at its boldest, set with full opaque lining, deep neckline and high-cut briefs, sculpted waist and long legs fully on show, unhurried commanding sensuality, direct gaze, short silk cami and shorts lifting in the night breeze
film: shot on Cinestill 800T, halation around the city lights

wardrobe.notes_ru: Короткая шёлковая двойка: топ на тонких бретелях и очень короткие шорты.
wardrobe.prompt: short ink-blue silk set, thin-strap cami with lace edging and very short matching silk shorts, heavy opaque silk, silver star pendant, hair loose and moving in the breeze, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Терраса на крыше тёплой ночью, свечи, город внизу.
location.prompt: rooftop terrace on a warm night, low stone parapet, clusters of lit candles, rattan lounge chair, olive tree in a pot, string lights unlit, city lights spread out far below

shots.pose: standing at the terrace parapet in the short silk set with the breeze lifting the hem, both hands on the stone behind her, back arched, head turned over her shoulder to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm candle clusters on the parapet from below, cool city glow behind her

shots.pose: sitting sideways in the low rattan chair with both legs draped over one arm of it, silk shorts riding high, one hand holding a glass, slow amused look down the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: candlelight close and warm on her skin, deep blue night beyond the terrace

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the wide stone parapet ledge, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm candlelight low and close on her skin, cool city glow drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: standing close to the dark glass of the terrace door, one hand flat on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, meeting the camera past her own reflection
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: warm candlelight low and close on her skin, cool city glow drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: standing at the open edge of the terrace above the city with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, the long line of her back and legs read against the light, head turned just enough to find the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm candlelight low and close on her skin, cool city glow drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: reclining back on the wide stone parapet ledge propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm candlelight low and close on her skin, cool city glow drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: standing tall at the edge of the terrace with the city behind her, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight on one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: warm candlelight low and close on her skin, cool city glow drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the silk hem lifting off her thigh in the breeze, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: warm candlelight low and close on her skin, cool city glow drawing her whole outline
